fields.description: Fires this Agent. Set this OR Workflow (not required to set both, but at least one is required — enforced in agent_trigger.py's validate()).
fields.label: Agent to Run

fields.description: The Frappe user this trigger's runs execute (and are permission-scoped) as. Use a dedicated service user for anything beyond low-stakes read-only agents.
fields.label: Run As User

fields.description: Standard cron expression, e.g. '0 * * * *' for hourly.
fields.label: Cron Expression

fields.description: Generated secret required in the webhook call's payload to authorize it.
fields.label: Webhook Token

fields.description: Jinja template rendered with the trigger's context (e.g. {{ doc.name }}, {{ doc.customer }} for a DocType Event). For an Agent-targeted trigger this becomes the agent's first message (required). For a Workflow-targeted trigger, leave this BLANK to pass the whole context — including the full 'doc' — straight through as the workflow's initial_input, unchanged; only fill this in if you want to reshape it, in which case it's rendered as Jinja then parsed as JSON (e.g. '{"customer": "{{ doc.customer }}"}').
fields.label: Input Template

fields.description: Optional Jinja/Python-expression guard evaluated against the same context before firing — e.g. 'doc.status == "Overdue"'. Leave blank to always fire.
fields.label: Condition (optional)

fields.description: Fires this Workflow instead of (or alongside) an Agent. When set, the rendered input_template/context is passed as the workflow's initial_input.
fields.label: Workflow to Run

fields.description: Set automatically by run_due_scheduled_triggers() — used to dedupe cron fires, not user-editable.
fields.label: Last Triggered At
